error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: We could not load this information.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: This reason is kept in the audit log.
reason.min: Type a reason of at least {min} characters.
reason.tooLong: The reason must not exceed {max} characters.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.effect: The account will no longer sign in nor pay. Its sessions will end at once.

suspendEmployee.effect: Their balance is kept but blocked: no payment and no allocation. Their family members will be suspended with them.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.effect: The account will be able to sign in again.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.effect: The account will be deactivated. It will no longer sign in.
deactivate.irreversible: This action is final. The deactivation cannot be undone.

deactivateEmployee.grace: The employee will be able to use the remaining balance for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, then the account will be closed.
deactivateEmployee.noCredit: No new credit can be allocated to them.
deactivateEmployee.family: Their family members will be deactivated with them.

role.title: Change the role of {name}?
role.effect: The rights of the account will change at once; its sessions will end.

reason.graceUnavailable: The grace period could not be loaded.

reactivateEmployee.effect: Only the family members suspended with them will be reactivated.

resend.title: Resend the invitation to {name}?
resend.effect: A new temporary password ({days} days) will be e-mailed; their sessions will end.

unlock.title: Unlock the PIN of {name}?
unlock.effect: The employee will be able to pay with their PIN again and will be told.
